rv.q: An excessive, extremely demanding — and not especially rewarding — new play composed by Phillip Howze, Six Characters premiered on Monday in a production by Lincoln Center Theater’s LCT3 division, which stages new works by promising new playwrights.

And if you have no idea how to go about that discovery, then you flop and flip and jump and howl your way from one space to another, from one wretched tumultuous attempt to another. Philip Howze’s Six Characters is a new take on Pirandello’s 1921 play Six Characters In Search of An Author.
